shape: someone waits a long time for something, and it arrives in a small way

slides.text: i spent four months waiting for someone to notice i was hiding in the stairwell.
every lunchtime the yard filled up, but i slipped behind the heavy fire doors with a squashed sandwich.
by november the concrete step was cold right through my trousers, but the noise out there was worse.
so i just sat in the dim light, counting the bolts on the handrail until the bell rang.
but on a wet thursday, you came down the steps carrying a cardboard box of paperbacks.
you didn't ask what was wrong, and you didn't tell me to go outside.
you just propped the library door open with a brick, and handed me the blue ink stamp.
[[you gave me somewhere to sit]] without ever making me say i had nowhere to go.

caption:
some people teach the syllabus, and some notice when a kid is running out of places to stand.
twenty years later, i still remember the quiet in that room.
send this to the teacher who left their door unlocked at lunch.

#childhoodmemories #schoolmemories #teacherappreciation
alt: a story about hiding in a school stairwell at lunch until a quiet teacher left the library door open and gave a place to sit.
